releaseNotes:
﻿## Conferences

- Printable one-page staff summary from conference overview (people, meals by day, dietary notes)
- Meal counts show clear "N ppl" totals with adults/children breakdown

## Bookings

- After saving a booking, return to the monthly calendar for that stay month
- Safer concurrent edits: warn when another user changed the booking before your save

## Backups

- Safer restore while the app is running (validate, safety copy, atomic replace, rollback)

## Guest Inbox

- Simplified email sidebar (removed Guest & booking link panel)

## Fixes

- Room conflict and staff-plan conflict handling improvements
